pages.text: The $(item)Picnic Basket$() is a bulk-storage block that accepts only $(thing)food items$(). It stores a large pool of any mix of edible items and can optionally feed the player automatically.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() to open the basket UI. Only items with a food component (anything you can eat) are accepted.$(br2)$(bold)Auto-feed$() is enabled by default: when the player's hunger bar is not full and the basket is nearby, it automatically consumes one food item to restore hunger.$(br2)The Picnic Basket connects to the $(l:network/network_interface)item network$() via a tube and is treated as a high-priority storage target by default.

pages.title: No Upgrades
pages.text: The Picnic Basket does not accept any upgrades. Its capacity is fixed at placement and cannot be increased.
